result.topic_en: The page holds bare arithmetic on induction readings: alternating sets of three values (about 1250 and about 790) are summed in adjacent pairs, the pair sums are combined into differences and further sums, and two totals are divided by 16.

methods.what: Three successive readings are summed in adjacent pairs, and the two pair sums are added (a combination that weights the middle reading double).
The doubled-weight sum of one group is subtracted from that of the next group to give a difference value.
Successive differences are summed pairwise, and those sums are added again.
The totals are divided by 16 to obtain means.
